title: Riesz $α$-capacity of Cantor sets and cyclicity in Dirichlet-type spaces
summary: We examine the threshold of the cyclicity for functions in Dirichlet-type spaces $\mathcal{D}_α$, $α\in(0,1]$. Given a fixed $α^{*}\in(0,1]$, we construct a holomorphic function $f\in\mathcal{D}_{α^{*}}$ which is cyclic in $\mathcal{D}_α$ for all $α<α^{*}$, but fails to be cyclic in $\mathcal{D}_{α^{*}}$. This function serves as a counterexample to the persistence of cyclicity at the critical index $α^{*}$. Throughout the construction process, we work with generalized Cantor sets and study their Riesz $α$-capacity.
